reviews.text: Thank you, Paul, for your review!

Amazing experience at Hello Vets with my kitten, Mochi! 🐾❤️ The whole team was so kind, caring, and gentle, making us both feel completely at ease. They clearly genuinely care about the animals they look after. Highly recommend Hello Vets — thank you for taking such great care of Mochi! 🐱💕
we love it here! so helpful and friendly, always quick to respond on whatsapp and our boy always feels so comfortable here!

I followed the reviews and took my kitten to get his first vaccines at Hello Vet Victoria Park today, and I’m so glad I did! The vet really took her time with him, giving him a chance to look around the room, and he barely reacted at all when the injection went in because she had taken the time to get him comfortable before. While we were waiting for our uber home my kitten got a little upset, and the lady on reception swiftly brought him a delicious treat which cheered him up! As a first time cat owner this was a wonderful and personal experience and I would definitely recommend

Wonderful vet, very intelligent vets ready to see you promptly. It gives such reassurance and so pleased that they are in Victoria Park Village. I also used the emergency vet service and it was fantastic. Can't thank you enough for all the support.

Hi Nastassia,
Thanks very much for this review, it really makes a difference to know people are happy with our service. Please do keep in touch, we'd love to hear from you!
Best wishes, Hannah

If i could give a score higher than 5 I would.  The space is calm, clean and well laid out.  My dog is very reactive and the whole team were very kind and supportive. The consultation was thorough with a detailed explanation and recommended next steps.  Holly checked in on her general health as well as the thing we presented for.  She really took time with my precious pooch. The other thing that I think is incredible is the communication and technology the surgery use. This allowed me to review after the appointment. Wonderful vetinary practice, that i highly recommend, I'm so glad we've moved to them.

Took Louie  to get his nails clipped today. Was our first time visiting Hello Pet.@ Victoria Park Village We were absolutely delighted at the service that met us. Clean, friendly bright and welcoming. Just want to say a big Thank you to. Louie felt at home. He sat still and gave no problems.
Big thank you. 🤩.

Excellent experience.  I have a very nervous older Chihuahua, who has been snappy when previously having his annual check and injections at a different vet.  The vet was wonderful with him and I was able to hold him whilst he was injected, which was a much calmer experience for all involved.  Following the appointment I received a written summary of his vet check, which was professional and thorough.  The appointment was arranged at a convenient time using WhatsApp which was efficient and the cost was less than my old vet.  Thank you!

I’m very happy with my experience at Hello Vet, they’re always very friendly and considerate. The first time I took my pet cat, we were early and they heard how anxious she was, so they saw us a little earlier. They gave her a detailed treatment plan and answered any questions, they also provided accurate price estimates so I know exactly what to expect. My pet cat is usually more anxious at the vet, but she didn’t try to run away or hiss here. She was calmer than usual and that’s always a good sign. I’d definitely recommend trying Hello Vet.

Had nothing but good experiences with hello vet so far. They are very knowledgeable, kind and considerate to our dog and to us as concerned parents. Their waiting rooms are spacious and packed with treats. If you are unsure about your current vet and are looking for a change we highly recommend them.

A great experience. Clean and generously sized waiting room and clinician. The vet was very helpful with our dog’s clinical needs, clear and transparent about pricing! Good follow up care too. Would definitely recommend!

This vet is absolutely amazing! The staff are lovely and having access to them through whatsapp for any concerns is perfect especially as a first dog owner. The place is clean and quite enjoyable on the eye. Highly recommend!!!

We were recommended this vet by a few people. My chihuahua had stomach issues, and we managed to get an early appointment the next day. The vet prescribed probiotics and worm treatment medicine and answered a few questions I had about my dog’s well-being.

They’re also very responsive on WhatsApp and can address any concerns you have. The receptionist even took a picture of my dog and put it on the wall! We definitely plan to return to this vet in the future.

We recently moved from another vet in Mile End because we felt there was no continuity — we saw a different vet each time and our dog’s history wasn’t really being followed. We also wanted a second opinion.

This was our second visit here and we’ve been very impressed. The team is professional, communication is excellent (especially the WhatsApp follow-ups), and the pricing is reasonable. They also have good availability for follow-up treatment, which was a big issue with our previous vet.

We’ll definitely be coming back.

I took my 2 cats Andrew and James for their annual vaccinations. James needed further treatment. I was very happy with the treatment, everything was explained, I felt informed and involved. I really like the treatment plan that I received for both my cats

Hello vet have been amazing with my dog, the staff and vets were all very lovely and supportive, my dog received great care and has healed nicely. Super easy to book appointments and stay in touch via whats app at all times, easy to get an appointment, venues are nice environments, welcoming and calming.

I changed here from Leyton Midland Vet who were an absolute nightmare to deal with…..AND WHAT AN ABSOLUTE BREATH OF FRESH AIR. Friendly, Efficient, stunning new surgery…..absolute gem of a place. Glad I switched over!!!

I have been to both Victoria Park and London Fields Hello Vet, and have always had a great experience. The staff are friendly and create a calming environment for your pet. My cat is always happy to get in his carrier knowing he is coming to the vets, and is super chill throughout the appointment. Thank you for always making it an enjoyable experience!

I I recently switched to Hello Vets, and it’s honestly been one of the best decisions I’ve made for my dog. He’s had difficult experiences at previous vets, so appointments have always been stressful.

The team at Hello Vets took so much time during his consultations and showed real patience and understanding. Because of that, they were able to successfully complete a full body examination on two different occasions! This is something he hasn’t been able to tolerate in over three years.

I’m incredibly grateful for their calm approach and the way they work with nervous dogs. It’s made such a difference to his care and our overall experience.
